scenes.title: Pricing is not a personality test.
scenes.body: It is scope first, then a number that lets you deliver well and still eat. Fancy frameworks can wait.
scenes.voice: Pricing is not a personality test. It is scope first, then a number that lets you deliver well and still eat. Fancy consulting frameworks can wait outside.

scenes.title: Never start with the number.
scenes.body: Start with what is included, what is excluded, how long it takes, and what 'done' looks like. The number comes last.
scenes.voice: The order. Never start with the number. Start with what is included, what is excluded, how long it actually takes, and what done looks like. The number comes last.

scenes.title: Write the outcome in one sentence.
scenes.body: What the buyer has when you are finished. Concrete beats impressive.
scenes.voice: Step one. Write the outcome in one sentence. What the buyer has when you are finished. Concrete beats impressive every time.

scenes.title: List the work. Be honest about hours.
scenes.body: Include the boring parts: revisions, admin, research, waiting on them. Then multiply by a sustainable hourly floor.
scenes.voice: Step two. List the actual work. Be honest about hours. Include the boring parts: revisions, admin, research, waiting on the client. Then multiply by a sustainable hourly floor you can live with.

scenes.title: Add the risk buffer.
scenes.body: New client? Unclear brief? Tight deadline? Add 20 to 40 percent. Underpricing is not a growth strategy.
scenes.voice: Step three. Add the risk buffer. New client? Unclear brief? Tight deadline? Add twenty to forty percent. Underpricing is not a growth strategy. It is a slow way to burn out.

scenes.title: Round to a clean number and explain it.
scenes.body: Prefer whole hundreds or simple packages. One sentence why this price protects the result.
scenes.voice: Step four. Round to a clean number and explain it. Prefer whole hundreds or simple packages. One sentence why this price protects the result for both of you.

scenes.title: What happens when scope creeps.
scenes.body: Write it down. Extra requests = new quote. Niceness without boundaries is just unpaid labor.
scenes.voice: Boundaries. What happens when scope creeps. Write it down. Extra requests become a new quote. Niceness without boundaries is just unpaid labor with better manners.

scenes.title: Price one real service today.
scenes.body: Use the four steps. Write the number. Put it on the one-page offer. Send it. Adjust only after real data.
scenes.voice: Your next move. Price one real service today. Use the four steps. Write the number. Put it on the one-page offer. Send it. Adjust only after real data, not after a panic spiral.

scenes.title: Pricing is not a personality test.
scenes.body: Scope first. Then a number you can deliver on.
scenes.voice: Pricing is not a personality test. Scope first. Then a number you can actually deliver on.

scenes.title: 1. One-sentence outcome
scenes.body: What they have when you finish.
scenes.voice: Four steps. One: one-sentence outcome. What they have when you finish.

scenes.title: 2. Honest hours + floor rate
scenes.body: Include the boring admin and waiting.
scenes.voice: Two: honest hours plus a sustainable floor rate. Include the boring admin and waiting.

scenes.title: 3. Risk buffer  4. Clean number + why
scenes.body: 20-40% buffer. Round clean. One sentence of protection.
scenes.voice: Three: risk buffer of twenty to forty percent. Four: clean number and one sentence why it protects the result.

scenes.title: Write the number. Send the offer.
scenes.body: Adjust after real data, not after panic.
scenes.voice: That is it. Write the number. Put it on the offer. Send it. Adjust after real data, not after panic. Details in the description.
